# Design Baseline

`design.md` — the product's design baseline at `.mochiko/product/design/`, beside the architecture store. Two parts in one file. The design truth part (platform, brand and voice, design principles, the evidence fence, the accessibility pointer) is durable and product-wide. The design system part (tokens, typography, components, motion) holds values as built and is written only from shipped code at a landing fold, never from intent; where it is still empty at landing, its first write is signed by the user at final acceptance. One writer, `product-designer`, on exactly three graded paths: the setup leg (the truth part, the brownfield system-part seed, the scaffold), a build-time `baseline-delta.md` entry, and the landing fold. Mode and the direction contract are per surface and live in the feature spec's Screens & Flows Direction block, never here; audience and purpose live in the product desk and are pointed at, never restated. Values, not stances: rendering strategy, state management, styling-system and component-library policy, and the a11y card are stances the architecture store deals as AX-XXX rows; a store row that needs a value points here, and this file never carries a stance. Where a stance and a value conflict, the stance wins and the conflict is a Drift entry at the next landing fold. No derived index.

## Header

Title "# Design Baseline" plus one line pointing at the product desk for audience and purpose. Governs no heading of its own.

## Platform

Truth part. The product's platform in one value — web, ios, android, adaptive, or desktop. Free text: an unrecognized value is recorded as given and warned, never silently defaulted.

## Brand and voice

Truth part. Brand commitments and the product's voice, each sourced from evidence the repo, README, or brand assets hold or the user stated. One line per commitment.

## Design principles

Truth part. The product's design principles, one line each, each a choice a builder could honor or violate.

## Evidence fence

Truth part. The evidence on hand, and the fence: claims, testimonials, benchmarks, customers, and pricing are never invented where evidence is absent.

## Accessibility

Truth part. A pointer to the accessibility standard of record — the `a11y` compliance module where the project's governance attaches it, else the Essential Floor line — and nothing else. The obligation is defined there, never restated here.

## Tokens — optional

System part. Color, spacing, radius, and elevation tokens as built, each with its value and the source file it lives in. Absent until setup seeds it or the first landing writes it.

## Typography — optional

System part. Font families and the type scale as built, with their source files.

## Components — optional

System part. The component inventory as built, one line each: name, source path, variants. Values only — a component-library policy is a stance and lives in the store.

## Motion — optional

System part. Durations, easing, and motion rules as built, with their source files.

## Drift — optional

Written by the landing fold only. One line per divergence — declared-versus-shipped, an unsigned or advisory critique finding, a design-audit divergence, or a stance-value conflict — keyed to the token or component and the FEAT-XXX that surfaced it.

## Conformance

Checked mechanically before the write lands. Each line is a string or a count, never a judgment.

- Required headings, in order: `## Platform`, `## Brand and voice`, `## Design principles`, `## Evidence fence`, `## Accessibility`
- An undeclared `##` heading is denied. `###` and deeper are yours.
- Line budgets, each counted from its `##` line to the next `##`, nested content included:
  - `## Platform` — 5 lines
  - `## Brand and voice` — 15 lines
  - `## Design principles` — 12 lines
  - `## Evidence fence` — 8 lines
  - `## Accessibility` — 5 lines
  - `## Tokens` — 30 lines (optional)
  - `## Typography` — 12 lines (optional)
  - `## Components` — 25 lines (optional)
  - `## Motion` — 8 lines (optional)
  - `## Drift` — 15 lines (optional)

## Skeleton

# Design Baseline

Audience and purpose: see the product desk.

## Platform

[web | ios | android | adaptive | desktop — or "not yet recorded"]

## Brand and voice

- [commitment, with its source]

## Design principles

- [principle a builder could honor or violate]

## Evidence fence

- On hand: [evidence, with its source]
- Never invented where evidence is absent: claims, testimonials, benchmarks, customers, pricing.

## Accessibility

Standard of record: [the `a11y` compliance module, or the Essential Floor line].

## Tokens

- color.primary — [value] — [source file]

## Typography

- [family] — scale [steps] — [source file]

## Components

- [Name] — [source path] — [variants]

## Motion

- [duration / easing rule] — [source file]

## Drift

- color.primary — declared [value], shipped [value] (FEAT-012)
